poc.description: Proof of concept / spike. Disposable code; minimal governance.

dev.description: Active development, not yet serving production traffic or real data.

prod.description: Production: serves real users or handles real data. Full governance applies.

internal.description: Used by our own teams only; no external exposure.

adrs.title: Every repo declares a classification and links to the repo of record
adrs.summary: Each SpecDev-managed repo declares its classification (one value per axis, e.g. maturity poc/dev/prod and audience internal/customer) in .specdev/org.json and enables the org-adr-check gate; org ADRs bind repos by classification.
